item: Row 463: feed addresses proposed for feed-less sources (R852)
key_paths: src/ingest/feed_proposals.py; src/ingest/crawl.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/ingest/pipeline.py; src/api/source_management.py; src/backup/merge.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; migrations/versions/c3f7a1e9d5b2_feed_proposals.py; tests/test_feed_proposals.py
summary: Feed links on a start page the crawl already fetched are recorded in memory as proposals for feed-less sources (http(s), no userinfo, length caps, internal names and addresses refused by writing after NFKC and IDNA, at most 3 per page, never resolved). One click accepts one proposal and sets rss_url; nothing is fetched before. A feed accepted this way keeps its entries to the source's own site (off_site_entries counted). Feeds another same-site source reads are never proposed or accepted; the same-host sibling path was dropped after both security reads. Backup merge carries proposals. Strings x12.
